cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've taken that bow you did. Now you'll choose me for the next dance, won't you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was checking my shoelace. The teacher said change partners.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, change. You could take your time changing. One more tune with me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can walk home together after class.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After class. Everyone else gets the dancing. Keep the seat beside you free while we change our shoes, then—just so I can hear you.
